notes.title: Hands Of Gold released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!!! 

The game Hands of Gold is finally available for purchase!!! Thanks to your enthusiasm during the pre-launch we worked on the game very fast and we are happy to announce that it is already available in its full version, with the different endings already all available, instead of its early access version!!! 

Thank you all and have fun!!!
